retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, warm-toned portrait of a musician seated outdoors with an acoustic guitar, featuring centered slab-serif display text.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist sans-serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A seated male figure in workwear and a red cap looks downward in a contemplative pose, flanked by an acoustic guitar against a weathered stone background, all unified by a grainy, desaturated sepia-wash filter.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head bowed
Acoustic guitar leaning diagonally in the lower-left foreground
Horizontal text band bisecting the subject's lap
Muted earth tones contrasted by a single saturated red accessory
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and low-contrast matte finish

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated subject occupies the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red baseball cap serves as the primary focal point against the muted background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the red cap, moves down the subject's arms to the central text, then follows the guitar neck to the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense, textured background with low-detail shadows in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and tans (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal (denim and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with crushed blacks and raised shadows for a vintage look.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended slab serif with high-waisted proportions
letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke weight with slight modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed edges to mimic weathered paint or letterpress
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; no secondary fonts.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic slab-serif structure and western feel.
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a tan work jacket and red cap sitting on stone steps with an acoustic guitar; apply a heavy sepia film grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the artist name in a wide, cream-colored slab-serif font across the center, applying a subtle 'dissolve' or 'grunge' texture to the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the red cap the only high-saturation element?
Does the typography have a weathered, slab-serif appearance?

mustRedesign: Ensure the guitar is an acoustic model, not electric
postGenerationChecks: Ensure subject's face is partially shadowed
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated musician + acoustic guitar + stone background + sepia filter + centered slab-serif text = Country Album Aesthetic
